//: Package configuration. The SPA emits TWO directories — dist/ (the server-served bundle) and dist-static/ (the single-file run-report template) — and the root task only declares dist/**. Without this, a turbo cache HIT on this package's build restores dist/ and leaves dist-static/ absent, and `moe-flight qa render` then dies with 'static template not found'. Nothing in the suite catches that, because the two render tests would have been cached too.
